ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between extensive central dark regions (black/dark-gray) and lateral peripheral light regions (cream/off-white); visible distribution ratio is approximately 65:35 dark-to-light.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation occupies the lower and medial fluke areas; light cream-colored regions are localized to the distal upper sections of both lobes; transition zones exhibit high-frequency, feather-like mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate aperture of 115 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency irregular serrations across the trailing edge with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; distinct jagged peaks visible along the entire upper boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep trajectory from the central notch towards the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, irregular white/gray pixel groups indicating barnacle colonies at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable barnacle encrustations at the tips of both lobes; a significant, non-uniform indentation on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive feathered or streaked transition pattern between the black and cream pigmented areas on both lobes.
